description: A client wants timber-look exterior panels for a tall building. I have not received the material specification, construction classification or sprinkler information. The pictures look like wood, but that is all I can say. Which approval route should we investigate?
known_facts: tall building described without measured height
material and construction details not received

missing_info.why: Appearance does not establish combustible-cladding applicability.

missing_info.field: height, occupancy, construction regime and sprinkler coverage
missing_info.why: Distinguish noncombustible, encapsulated mass timber and other applicable routes.

missing_info.field: wall assembly, spatial separation and proposed evidence
missing_info.why: Establish the permission or actual departure rather than presume one.

should_cite.why: Candidate for combustible cladding on required noncombustible construction.
Candidate if the building is encapsulated mass timber.

gold.engineering_reason: Tall is not a code height or occupancy classification; actual size, use, work and design basis must establish the professional trigger.
